$comment: Hosts and identifiers that must never appear in runtime code, config, built assets, or CI workflows. Enforced by the domain scanner (see docs/NETWORK_BOUNDARY.md). Attribution, migration docs, and test fixtures are allowlisted by path.

forbidden.reason: OpenWhispr hosted auth. Still injected by upstream CI as the VITE_AUTH_URL default, past an unguarded getAuthUrl() — this is the specific regression the scanner exists to catch.
Any OpenWhispr host, including the OAuth desktop-callback shim
Pluely backend, licensing, payments, and updater
Vendor-controlled whisper.cpp fork. Build-time dependency on the vendor's GitHub org, invisible to a host-only blocklist. Use upstream ggml-org/whisper.cpp at a pinned tag, or our own fork.
The AEC helper and five Windows helpers download from vendor release assets. Rebuild and publish under this project's own releases.
Analytics. Pluely ships tauri-plugin-posthog; we ship no telemetry.
Paid-plan gating. No capability may be gated behind a plan.
Upstream's paid/BYOK build flag. BYOK is the only mode here, so the flag must not exist.

$scanPathsComment: Workflows and built assets are in scope deliberately. Upstream's live auth.openwhispr.com leak lives in .github/workflows and is invisible to a src/-only scan; a leaked host can also survive only in a bundled asset.

allowlist.reason: Audit, porting, and migration documentation must name what was removed.
This file necessarily contains the patterns it forbids.
Frozen record of the upstream surface, including vendor identifiers.
Declares vendor services as removed-vendor-service by name.
Fixtures that assert the scanner works.

$runtimeBlockedHostsComment: Compiled into crates/network-policy via include_str! and enforced per request as defense in depth behind the CI scanner. Host suffixes only -- the identifier patterns above are source-scanner concerns and have no runtime meaning.
$egressComment: Mirrors the RequestPurpose enum in crates/network-policy. Every outbound request must declare one; there is no default and no unlabelled path.
